title: Evaluation runner: the same requests with and without the skill on the local model
goal: nerv skills evaluate grades measured replies, not hand-written ones
acceptance: Owner 2026-11-27 in chat: "ok" to starting the first real skills, a Grover check for "controlla se è richiesta un'altra dose"; read-only.

evals/skill-evaluation-run.mjs asks the local model (loopback Ollama only) twice per case over the same invented tool results, once with the skill instructions in the system prompt, and writes a copy of the suite with baselineOutput and withSkillOutput to a new file; without --allow-models --execute --out it only plans

It measures the instructions on the plain model, not through NERV's planner: applying a skill at run time is F-146-T03. F-146-T05 can reuse this runner for the pre-flight skill (F-146 is an adopted plan: that change is the owner's to approve)

Tests with a fake fetch: plan mode calls nothing; a run sends both prompts and writes both replies; a remote endpoint, a run without --out, an existing out file and a case without a fixture are refused
privacy: Invented tent, pot and readings only in Git and tests; the owner's real Grover data stays on the owner's machines.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A skill that could start a feed or any other effect is out of scope and goes to the owner as a separate decision

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27: a small runner on the speed benchmark's loopback pattern, with fake-model tests. Not a measurement.
